notes.title: Up Down All-a-Round 1v1 Update
notes.content:
[h3][u][b]Whats new?[/h3][/b][/u]

1v1s has replaced the greyed out "hold it" gamemode, no work was ever done on hold it so nothing was lost. 1v1 pits you against another player in a small and comfy arena I hope you'll enjoy it!

[h3][u][b]Localisation Added[/b][/u][/h3]

Language options have been added for the following languges
- French
- German
- Spanish
- Russian
- Italian
- Portuguese

Some languages have been implented a little rough but for now their fine.

Hope you enjoy, thanks for playing!

notes.title: New Update Releasing Soon
notes.content:
[h3][h2][h1][u][b]Hi there[/b][/u][/h1][/h2][/h3]

It has been awhile since the last update, and a new one is coming.

The new update will bring a new mode that is replacing the "Hold it" Gamemode. No work was ever done on hold it just an idea of how it would work. I thought about the work that would have to go into implementing it and decided to scrap it. Instead there will be a new gamemode called 1v1 where you guessed it you 1v1 people. You will be in a small arena with a glock and shotgun!

[h3][u][b]LOCALISATION[/b][/u][/h3]
Also coming in the next update is localisation, don't speak english? Not a problem, next update will add different languages to choose from. Their implementation might be a little rough but hey at least their there!

Until the update is released good bye!

notes.title: Up Down All-a-Round Tubes Update
notes.content:
The tubes update is now out, experience a awesome new gamemode called Tubes. In Tubes you race to the end of the stage and reach the goalpost in time. You will be scored accordingly and be added to leaderboard! 

There are also some new face customization options added, if you haven't check out the customization dlc to unlock these awesome stuff!

Bugfixes like being able to clip out the map have been fixed, fixed a performance issue when it came to the settings menu and made the muzzleflash effect smaller it was pretty big!

Please enjoy this new update and try climbing the Tubes leaderboards!

notes.title: Up Down All-a-Round Content Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hey shifters it has been awhile but the new content update for Up Down All-a-Round is almost here! The update will bring a new gamemode know as Tubes, in this gamemode you traverse through tubes to get to the goal post! This new gamemode brings with it a leaderboard, get the best score in Tubes and try and get to number one! 

There will also be 6 new Face customization options added along with some bugfixes!
